from aws_cdk import CfnOutput
from aws_cdk import aws_budgets as budgets
from aws_cdk import aws_iam as iam
from aws_cdk import aws_sns as sns
from constructs import Construct


class BillingAlarms(Construct):
    """Monitor organizational billing and send alerts when spending thresholds are exceeded.

    This component creates AWS Budgets to track spend and forecasted spend against a $100M
    threshold, sending notifications to an SNS topic whenever either actual spend or
    forecasted spend exceeds the limit.
    """

    def __init__(self, scope: Construct, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(scope, "BillingAlarms", **kwargs)

        # SNS Topic for billing alerts
        self.billing_alarm_topic = sns.Topic(
            self, "BillingAlarmTopic", display_name="org-billing-alarms"
        )

        # Allow AWS Budgets service to publish to the SNS topic
        sns.TopicPolicy(
            self,
            "BillingAlarmTopicPolicy",
            topics=[self.billing_alarm_topic],
            policy_document=iam.PolicyDocument(
                statements=[
                    iam.PolicyStatement(
                        actions=["sns:Publish"],
                        effect=iam.Effect.ALLOW,
                        principals=[iam.ServicePrincipal("budgets.amazonaws.com")],
                        resources=[self.billing_alarm_topic.topic_arn],
                    )
                ]
            ),
        )

        # Budget for actual spend threshold at 100% ($100M)
        actual_spend_budget = budgets.CfnBudget(
            self,
            "ActualSpendBudget",
            budget={
                "budget_limit": {
                    "amount": "100000000",
                    "unit": "USD",
                },
                "budget_name": "org-actual-spend-budget",
                "budget_type": "COST",
                "time_period": {
                    "start": "2024-01-01",
                    "end": "2099-12-31",
                },
                "time_unit": "MONTHLY",
            },
            notifications_with_subscribers=[
                budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationWithSubscribersProperty(
                    notification=budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationProperty(
                        comparison_operator="GREATER_THAN",
                        notification_type="ACTUAL",
                        threshold=100.0,
                        threshold_type="PERCENTAGE",
                    ),
                    subscribers=[
                        budgets.CfnBudget.SubscriberProperty(
                            address=self.billing_alarm_topic.topic_arn,
                            subscription_type="SNS",
                        )
                    ],
                )
            ],
        )

        # Budget for forecasted spend threshold at 100% ($100M)
        forecasted_spend_budget = budgets.CfnBudget(
            self,
            "ForecastedSpendBudget",
            budget={
                "budget_limit": {
                    "amount": "100000000",
                    "unit": "USD",
                },
                "budget_name": "org-forecasted-spend-budget",
                "budget_type": "COST",
                "time_period": {
                    "start": "2024-01-01",
                    "end": "2099-12-31",
                },
                "time_unit": "MONTHLY",
            },
            notifications_with_subscribers=[
                budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationWithSubscribersProperty(
                    notification=budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationProperty(
                        comparison_operator="GREATER_THAN",
                        notification_type="FORECASTED",
                        threshold=100.0,
                        threshold_type="PERCENTAGE",
                    ),
                    subscribers=[
                        budgets.CfnBudget.SubscriberProperty(
                            address=self.billing_alarm_topic.topic_arn,
                            subscription_type="SNS",
                        )
                    ],
                )
            ],
        )

        # Output the SNS topic ARN for external subscription
        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "BillingAlarmTopicArn",
            description="Billing alarm topic ARN for subscription.",
            value=self.billing_alarm_topic.topic_arn,
        )

from aws_cdk import CfnOutput
from aws_cdk import aws_budgets as budgets
from aws_cdk import aws_sns as sns
from constructs import Construct


class BillingAlarms(Construct):
    """Create billing alarms for organization spend monitoring.

    This component sets up AWS Budgets to monitor organization spend and sends
    notifications to an SNS topic when spending reaches $100M or when forecasting
    indicates the organization will exceed $100M.
    """

    def __init__(self, scope: Construct, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(scope, "BillingAlarms", **kwargs)

        # SNS Topic for billing alarms
        self.billing_alarm_topic = sns.Topic(
            self, "BillingAlarmTopic", display_name="org-billing-alarms"
        )

        # Budget for actual spending over $100M
        budgets.CfnBudget(
            self,
            "ActualSpendBudget",
            budget=budgets.CfnBudget.BudgetDataProperty(
                budget_limit=budgets.CfnBudget.SpendProperty(
                    amount="100000000",
                    unit="USD",
                ),
                budget_name="Organization-Actual-Spend-100M",
                budget_type="COST",
                time_period=budgets.CfnBudget.TimePeriodProperty(
                    start="2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
                    end="2087-12-31T23:59:59Z",
                ),
                time_unit="MONTHLY",
            ),
            notifications_with_subscribers=[
                budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationWithSubscribersProperty(
                    notification=budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationProperty(
                        comparison_operator="GREATER_THAN",
                        notification_type="ACTUAL",
                        threshold=100,
                        threshold_type="PERCENTAGE",
                    ),
                    subscribers=[
                        budgets.CfnBudget.SubscriberProperty(
                            address=self.billing_alarm_topic.topic_arn,
                            subscription_type="SNS",
                        )
                    ],
                )
            ],
        )

        # Budget for forecasted spending over $100M
        budgets.CfnBudget(
            self,
            "ForecastedSpendBudget",
            budget=budgets.CfnBudget.BudgetDataProperty(
                budget_limit=budgets.CfnBudget.SpendProperty(
                    amount="100000000",
                    unit="USD",
                ),
                budget_name="Organization-Forecasted-Spend-100M",
                budget_type="COST",
                time_period=budgets.CfnBudget.TimePeriodProperty(
                    start="2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
                    end="2087-12-31T23:59:59Z",
                ),
                time_unit="MONTHLY",
            ),
            notifications_with_subscribers=[
                budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationWithSubscribersProperty(
                    notification=budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationProperty(
                        comparison_operator="GREATER_THAN",
                        notification_type="FORECASTED",
                        threshold=100,
                        threshold_type="PERCENTAGE",
                    ),
                    subscribers=[
                        budgets.CfnBudget.SubscriberProperty(
                            address=self.billing_alarm_topic.topic_arn,
                            subscription_type="SNS",
                        )
                    ],
                )
            ],
        )

        # Output the SNS topic ARN for external subscription
        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "BillingAlarmTopicArn",
            description="Billing alarm topic ARN for subscription.",
            value=self.billing_alarm_topic.topic_arn,
        )

from aws_cdk import CfnOutput
from aws_cdk import aws_budgets as budgets
from aws_cdk import aws_sns as sns
from constructs import Construct


class BillingAlarm(Construct):
    """Monitor monthly billing spend and forecasted spend for the organization.

    This component creates SNS topic to receive billing alerts and configures
    AWS Budgets to send notifications when:
    - Actual monthly spend exceeds $100M
    - Forecasted monthly spend exceeds $100M
    """

    def __init__(self, scope: Construct, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(scope, "BillingAlarm", **kwargs)

        # SNS Topic for billing alarms
        self.billing_alarm_topic = sns.Topic(
            self, "BillingAlarmTopic", display_name="org-billing-alarms"
        )

        # Budget for monitoring actual spend
        actual_spend_budget = budgets.CfnBudget(
            self,
            "ActualSpendBudget",
            budget=budgets.CfnBudget.BudgetDataProperty(
                budget_name="organization-actual-spend-100m",
                budget_type="COST",
                time_unit="MONTHLY",
                budget_limit=budgets.CfnBudget.SpendProperty(
                    amount=100000000,
                    unit="USD",
                ),
            ),
            notifications_with_subscribers=[
                budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationWithSubscribersProperty(
                    notification=budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationProperty(
                        notification_type="ACTUAL",
                        comparison_operator="GREATER_THAN",
                        threshold=100,
                        threshold_type="PERCENTAGE",
                    ),
                    subscribers=[
                        budgets.CfnBudget.SubscriberProperty(
                            subscription_type="SNS",
                            address=self.billing_alarm_topic.topic_arn,
                        )
                    ],
                )
            ],
        )

        # Budget for monitoring forecasted spend
        forecasted_spend_budget = budgets.CfnBudget(
            self,
            "ForecastedSpendBudget",
            budget=budgets.CfnBudget.BudgetDataProperty(
                budget_name="organization-forecasted-spend-100m",
                budget_type="COST",
                time_unit="MONTHLY",
                budget_limit=budgets.CfnBudget.SpendProperty(
                    amount=100000000,
                    unit="USD",
                ),
            ),
            notifications_with_subscribers=[
                budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationWithSubscribersProperty(
                    notification=budgets.CfnBudget.NotificationProperty(
                        notification_type="FORECASTED",
                        comparison_operator="GREATER_THAN",
                        threshold=100,
                        threshold_type="PERCENTAGE",
                    ),
                    subscribers=[
                        budgets.CfnBudget.SubscriberProperty(
                            subscription_type="SNS",
                            address=self.billing_alarm_topic.topic_arn,
                        )
                    ],
                )
            ],
        )

        # Output the SNS topic ARN for external subscription
        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "SNSTopicArn",
            description="Billing alarm topic ARN for subscription.",
            value=self.billing_alarm_topic.topic_arn,
        )

"""AWS Config setup for organization-wide compliance monitoring.

This module enables AWS Config recording across all AWS regions (current and future),
establishes an organization-wide aggregator, and applies managed rules including
CloudTrail enablement checks across all accounts in the organization.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from aws_cdk import (
    CfnOutput,
    RemovalPolicy,
    Stack,
    aws_config as config,
    aws_iam as iam,
    aws_s3 as s3,
)
from constructs import Construct


class AwsConfigSetup(Construct):
    """Set up AWS Config with organization-wide aggregation and compliance rules.

    This construct:
    - Enables AWS Config recording in all current and future regions
    - Creates an S3 bucket for Config snapshots and history
    - Sets up an organization-wide aggregator
    - Applies managed rules for compliance checking (CloudTrail enablement check)

    Args:
        scope: The CDK construct scope (typically a Stack).
        construct_id: Logical ID for this construct.
        organization_arn: The ARN of the AWS Organization.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        scope: Construct,
        construct_id: str,
        *,
        organization_arn: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize the AWS Config setup.

        Args:
            scope: The CDK construct scope.
            construct_id: Logical ID for this construct.
            organization_arn: The ARN of the AWS Organization.
        """
        super().__init__(scope, construct_id)

        self._organization_arn = organization_arn
        self._stack = Stack.of(scope)

        # Create S3 bucket for Config snapshots and history
        self._config_bucket = self._create_config_bucket()

        # Enable AWS Config recording in all regions
        self._setup_recorder()

        # Set up organization-wide aggregator
        self._setup_organization_aggregator()

        # Apply managed rules
        self._apply_managed_rules()

    def _create_config_bucket(self) -> s3.Bucket:
        """Create an S3 bucket for AWS Config snapshots and history.

        Returns:
            The created S3 bucket resource.
        """
        bucket = s3.Bucket(
            self,
            "ConfigBucket",
            bucket_name=f"aws-config-bucket-{self._stack.account}-{self._stack.region}",
            encryption=s3.BucketEncryption.S3_MANAGED,
            block_public_access=s3.BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL,
            versioned=True,
            removal_policy=RemovalPolicy.RETAIN,
            enforce_ssl=True,
        )

        # Add bucket policy to allow AWS Config to write to it
        bucket.add_to_resource_policy(
            iam.PolicyStatement(
                effect=iam.Effect.ALLOW,
                principals=[iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com")],
                actions=["s3:GetBucketVersioning", "s3:PutObject", "s3:GetObject"],
                resources=[bucket.bucket_arn, bucket.arn_for_objects("*")],
            )
        )

        return bucket

    def _setup_recorder(self) -> None:
        """Set up AWS Config recorder to record in all regions.

        The configuration uses CloudFormation to ensure recording is enabled
        across all current and future regions.
        """
        # Create IAM role for Config recorder
        config_role = iam.Role(
            self,
            "ConfigRole",
            assumed_by=iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com"),
            managed_policies=[
                iam.ManagedPolicy.from_aws_managed_policy_name(
                    "service-role/ConfigRole"
                ),
                iam.ManagedPolicy.from_aws_managed_policy_name(
                    "service-role/config.amazonaws.com"
                ),
            ],
        )

        # Add additional permissions for S3 bucket
        config_role.add_to_policy(
            iam.PolicyStatement(
                effect=iam.Effect.ALLOW,
                actions=[
                    "s3:GetBucketVersioning",
                    "s3:PutObject",
                    "s3:GetObject",
                ],
                resources=[
                    self._config_bucket.bucket_arn,
                    self._config_bucket.arn_for_objects("*"),
                ],
            )
        )

        # Create Config recorder - this enables recording in the current region
        recorder = config.CfnConfigurationRecorder(
            self,
            "ConfigRecorder",
            role_arn=config_role.role_arn,
            recording_group=config.CfnConfigurationRecorder.RecordingGroupProperty(
                all_supported=True,
                include_global_resources=True,
            ),
        )

        # Create delivery channel for the recorder
        delivery_channel = config.CfnDeliveryChannel(
            self,
            "ConfigDeliveryChannel",
            s3_bucket_name=self._config_bucket.bucket_name,
            depends_on=[recorder],
        )

        # Start the recorder
        recorder.add_depends_on(delivery_channel)

    def _setup_organization_aggregator(self) -> None:
        """Set up an organization-wide aggregator for AWS Config."""
        # Create organization aggregator
        aggregator = config.CfnConfigurationAggregator(
            self,
            "OrganizationAggregator",
            account_aggregation_sources=[
                config.CfnConfigurationAggregator.AccountAggregationSourceProperty(
                    all_aws_regions=True,
                    account_ids=[self._stack.account],
                )
            ],
            configuration_aggregator_name="organization-aggregator",
        )

        # Authorization for organization aggregator (if in management account)
        # This allows member accounts to aggregate their data to this aggregator
        auth = config.CfnAggregationAuthorization(
            self,
            "AggregationAuthorization",
            account_id=self._stack.account,
            aws_region="us-east-1",
        )

        auth.add_depends_on(aggregator)

    def _apply_managed_rules(self) -> None:
        """Apply AWS Config managed rules for compliance checking.

        Applies the CloudTrail enablement managed rule across the organization.
        """
        # CloudTrail enabled managed rule
        cloudtrail_rule = config.CfnConfigRule(
            self,
            "CloudTrailEnabledRule",
            config_rule_name="cloudtrail-enabled",
            description="Checks whether CloudTrail is enabled in the AWS account.",
            source=config.CfnConfigRule.SourceProperty(
                owner="AWS",
                source_identifier="CLOUD_TRAIL_ENABLED",
            ),
            scope=config.CfnConfigRule.ScopeProperty(
                compliance_resource_types=["AWS::CloudTrail::Trail"],
            ),
        )

        # Output the aggregator name
        if isinstance(self._stack, Stack):
            CfnOutput(
                self,
                "ConfigAggregatorName",
                description="Name of the AWS Config Organization Aggregator",
                value="organization-aggregator",
            )

            CfnOutput(
                self,
                "ConfigBucketName",
                description="Name of the S3 bucket for AWS Config data",
                value=self._config_bucket.bucket_name,
            )

from aws_cdk import (
    CfnOutput,
    Stack,
    aws_config as config,
    aws_iam as iam,
    aws_s3 as s3,
)
from constructs import Construct


class AwsConfigSetup(Construct):
    """Enable AWS Config recording across all regions and set up organization-wide aggregator.

    This construct:
    1. Creates an S3 bucket for Config snapshots and recorded items
    2. Sets up AWS Config recording with all-resources delivery
    3. Creates an organization-wide aggregator for multi-account/multi-region compliance
    4. Applies CloudTrail enabled validation managed rule
    """

    def __init__(self, scope: Construct, **kwargs) -> None:
        super().__init__(scope, "AwsConfigSetup", **kwargs)

        # S3 bucket for AWS Config snapshots and recorded items
        config_bucket = s3.Bucket(
            self,
            "ConfigBucket",
            block_public_access=s3.BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL,
            encryption=s3.BucketEncryption.S3_MANAGED,
            versioned=True,
        )

        # IAM Role for AWS Config
        config_role = iam.Role(
            self,
            "ConfigRole",
            assumed_by=iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com"),
            managed_policies=[
                iam.ManagedPolicy.from_aws_managed_policy_name(
                    "service-role/ConfigRole"
                ),
            ],
        )

        # Add inline policy for S3 bucket access
        config_role.add_inline_policy(
            "ConfigBucketAccess",
            iam.PolicyDocument(
                statements=[
                    iam.PolicyStatement(
                        actions=[
                            "s3:GetBucketVersioning",
                            "s3:PutObject",
                            "s3:GetObject",
                        ],
                        effect=iam.Effect.ALLOW,
                        resources=[
                            config_bucket.bucket_arn,
                            f"{config_bucket.bucket_arn}/*",
                        ],
                    )
                ]
            ),
        )

        # AWS Config Recorder to capture all resources in all regions
        recorder = config.CfnConfigurationRecorder(
            self,
            "ConfigRecorder",
            role_arn=config_role.role_arn,
            recording_group=config.CfnConfigurationRecorder.RecordingGroupProperty(
                all_supported=True,
                include_global_resources=True,
            ),
        )

        # Delivery channel to send snapshots to S3
        delivery_channel = config.CfnDeliveryChannel(
            self,
            "DeliveryChannel",
            s3_bucket_name=config_bucket.bucket_name,
        )

        # Recorder must start before we can create aggregator
        recorder.add_dependency(delivery_channel)

        # Start the recorder
        recorder_status = config.CfnConfigurationRecorder(
            self,
            "ConfigRecorderStarted",
            role_arn=config_role.role_arn,
            recording_group=config.CfnConfigurationRecorder.RecordingGroupProperty(
                all_supported=True,
                include_global_resources=True,
            ),
        )

        # Create organization-wide aggregator for multi-account/multi-region compliance
        aggregator = config.CfnConfigurationAggregator(
            self,
            "OrganizationAggregator",
            account_aggregation_sources=[
                config.CfnConfigurationAggregator.AccountAggregationSourceProperty(
                    account_ids=None,  # Will aggregate all accounts in the organization
                    all_aws_regions=True,  # All current and future regions
                )
            ],
            authorization_details=[
                config.CfnConfigurationAggregator.AuthorizationDetailProperty(
                    account_id=Stack.of(self).account,
                )
            ],
        )

        # Managed rule: CloudTrail enabled validation
        cloudtrail_rule = config.CfnConfigRule(
            self,
            "CloudTrailEnabledRule",
            description="Checks whether CloudTrail is enabled on the AWS account",
            config_rule_name="cloudtrail-enabled",
            source=config.CfnConfigRule.SourceProperty(
                owner="AWS",
                source_identifier="CLOUD_TRAIL_ENABLED",
            ),
        )

        # Output the S3 bucket name for reference
        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "ConfigBucketName",
            description="S3 bucket used for AWS Config snapshots and recorded items",
            value=config_bucket.bucket_name,
        )

        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "AggregatorArn",
            description="ARN of the organization-wide AWS Config aggregator",
            value=aggregator.attr_configuration_aggregator_arn,
        )

        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "CloudTrailRuleName",
            description="Name of the CloudTrail enabled validation rule",
            value=cloudtrail_rule.attr_config_rule_name,
        )

"""AWS Config setup for organization-wide recording and compliance tracking.

This module enables AWS Config recording across all regions with organization-wide
aggregation and managed rules for compliance monitoring.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from aws_cdk import (
    CfnOutput,
    RemovalPolicy,
    Stack,
    aws_config as config,
    aws_iam as iam,
    aws_kms as kms,
    aws_s3 as s3,
)
from aws_cdk.aws_organizations import CfnOrganization
from constructs import Construct


class AwsConfigSetup(Construct):
    """Enable AWS Config recording and organization-wide aggregation.

    This construct:
    - Creates an S3 bucket for Config snapshots
    - Enables Config recording in all regions
    - Sets up organization-wide aggregation
    - Applies managed rule to check CloudTrail is enabled
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        scope: Construct,
        construct_id: str,
        *,
        organization: CfnOrganization,
        account_id: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Instantiate the AWS Config setup.

        Args:
            scope: CDK scope.
            construct_id: Logical ID for this construct.
            organization: The CfnOrganization resource.
            account_id: The AWS account ID where Config will be deployed.
        """
        super().__init__(scope, construct_id)

        # Create KMS key for S3 encryption
        kms_key = kms.Key(
            self,
            "ConfigKmsKey",
            description="KMS key for AWS Config snapshots encryption",
            enable_key_rotation=True,
            removal_policy=RemovalPolicy.RETAIN,
        )

        # Create S3 bucket for Config snapshots
        config_bucket = s3.Bucket(
            self,
            "ConfigBucket",
            encryption=s3.BucketEncryption.KMS,
            encryption_key=kms_key,
            block_public_access=s3.BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL,
            versioned=True,
            removal_policy=RemovalPolicy.RETAIN,
            enforce_ssl=True,
        )

        # Create IAM role for Config
        config_role = iam.Role(
            self,
            "ConfigRole",
            assumed_by=iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com"),
            description="Role for AWS Config service",
        )

        # Attach the AWS managed policy for Config
        config_role.add_managed_policy(
            iam.ManagedPolicy.from_aws_managed_policy_name(
                "ConfigRole"
            )
        )

        # Add permissions to access the S3 bucket
        config_bucket.grant_read_write(config_role)
        config_bucket.add_to_resource_policy(
            iam.PolicyStatement(
                principals=[iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com")],
                actions=["s3:GetBucketVersioning"],
                resources=[config_bucket.bucket_arn],
            )
        )

        # Add permissions to the KMS key
        kms_key.grant_encrypt_decrypt(config_role)

        # Create Config Recorder for all regions
        recorder = config.CfnConfigurationRecorder(
            self,
            "ConfigRecorder",
            role_arn=config_role.role_arn,
            recording_group=config.CfnConfigurationRecorder.RecordingGroupProperty(
                all_supported=True,
                all_supported_resources_with_resources_enabled=True,
            ),
        )

        # Create Delivery Channel
        delivery_channel = config.CfnDeliveryChannel(
            self,
            "ConfigDeliveryChannel",
            s3_bucket_name=config_bucket.bucket_name,
            sns_topic_arn_for_notifications=None,
        )

        # Start the recorder
        recorder.node.add_dependency(delivery_channel)

        # Enable recorder
        from aws_cdk import CfnResource
        start_recorder = config.CfnConfigurationRecorder(
            self,
            "ConfigRecorderStarted",
            role_arn=config_role.role_arn,
            recording_group=config.CfnConfigurationRecorder.RecordingGroupProperty(
                all_supported=True,
                all_supported_resources_with_resources_enabled=True,
            ),
        )

        # Apply CloudTrail enabled managed rule
        cloudtrail_rule = config.CfnConfigRule(
            self,
            "CloudTrailEnabledRule",
            config_rule_name="cloudtrail-enabled",
            description="Checks if CloudTrail is enabled in the AWS account.",
            source=config.CfnConfigRule.SourceProperty(
                owner="AWS",
                source_identifier="CLOUD_TRAIL_ENABLED",
            ),
            scope=config.CfnConfigRule.ScopeProperty(
                compliance_resource_types=None,
            ),
        )

        # Ensure ConfigRule depends on recorder
        cloudtrail_rule.node.add_dependency(recorder)

        # Output bucket name
        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "ConfigBucketName",
            description="S3 bucket for AWS Config snapshots",
            value=config_bucket.bucket_name,
        )


class AwsConfigAggregator(Construct):
    """Create an organization-wide AWS Config aggregator.

    This construct sets up a centralized aggregator that collects Config data
    from all accounts in the organization.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        scope: Construct,
        construct_id: str,
        *,
        organization: CfnOrganization,
        account_id: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Instantiate the AWS Config aggregator.

        Args:
            scope: CDK scope.
            construct_id: Logical ID for this construct.
            organization: The CfnOrganization resource.
            account_id: The AWS account ID where the aggregator will be deployed.
        """
        super().__init__(scope, construct_id)

        # Get the organization ID and root ID
        org_id = organization.attr_id

        # Create organization-wide aggregator
        aggregator = config.CfnConfigurationAggregator(
            self,
            "OrgAggregator",
            configuration_aggregator_name="organization-aggregator",
            account_aggregation_sources=[
                config.CfnConfigurationAggregator.AccountAggregationSourceProperty(
                    account_ids=[account_id],  # This is the authorizer account
                    aws_regions=["us-east-1"],  # Will be expanded via automation
                    all_aws_regions=True,  # Enable all regions
                )
            ],
            organization_aggregation_sources=[
                config.CfnConfigurationAggregator.OrganizationAggregationSourceProperty(
                    all_aws_regions=True,  # Collect from all regions
                    role_arn=self._create_aggregator_role(scope).role_arn,
                    organization_unit_names=[],
                )
            ],
        )

        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "AggregatorName",
            description="Name of the organization-wide Config aggregator",
            value=aggregator.configuration_aggregator_name or "organization-aggregator",
        )

    def _create_aggregator_role(self, scope: Construct) -> iam.Role:
        """Create IAM role for the aggregator.

        Args:
            scope: CDK scope.

        Returns:
            The IAM role for Config aggregation.
        """
        role = iam.Role(
            scope,
            "ConfigAggregatorRole",
            assumed_by=iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com"),
            description="Role for AWS Config aggregator",
        )

        # Add the AWS managed policy for aggregator authorization
        role.add_managed_policy(
            iam.ManagedPolicy.from_aws_managed_policy_name(
                "service-role/AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations"
            )
        )

        return role

        management_account_id: The AWS account ID of the organization's
            management account
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        scope: Construct,
        organization: CfnOrganization,
        management_account_id: str,
        **kwargs,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize the OrganizationConfigSetup construct.

        Args:
            scope: CDK construct scope
            organization: The root-level CfnOrganization resource
            management_account_id: The AWS account ID of the organization's
                management account
            **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments passed to parent Construct
        """
        super().__init__(scope, "OrganizationConfigSetup", **kwargs)

        # Store organization ID for aggregator authorization
        organization_id = organization.attr_id

        # Get the root stack (parent) to access account and region information
        root_stack = self._get_root_stack()
        management_account_arn = (
            f"arn:aws:organizations::{management_account_id}:organization/{organization_id}"
        )

        # Create a ConfigurationRecorder for the management account that records
        # all resource types in all regions
        self._setup_config_recorder()

        # Create the organization aggregator to collect Config data from all accounts
        self._setup_organization_aggregator(
            aggregator_account=management_account_id,
            organization_arn=management_account_arn,
        )

        # Apply the CloudTrail trail enabled managed rule
        self._apply_cloudtrail_trail_enabled_rule()

    def _setup_config_recorder(self) -> None:
        """Setup AWS Config recorder for the management account.

        Configures the recorder to:
        - Record all resource types
        - Include global resources
        - Use all supported regions (current and future)
        """

            self,

            recording_group=config.CfnConfigurationRecorder.RecordingGroupProperty(
                all_supported=True,
                include_global_resources=True,

            ),

        delivery_channel = config.CfnDeliveryChannel(
            self,

            s3_bucket_name=self._create_config_bucket(),
            sns_topic_arn=self._get_or_create_config_sns_topic().topic_arn,
            config_snapshot_delivery_properties=config.CfnDeliveryChannel.ConfigSnapshotDeliveryPropertiesProperty(
                delivery_frequency="Six_Hours"

        )

            self,
            "ConfigurationRecorderStatus",
            configuration_recorder_name=recorder.ref,
            is_enabled=True,
            depends_on=[delivery_channel],

            iam.PolicyStatement(
                effect=iam.Effect.ALLOW,
                principals=[iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com")],
                actions=["SNS:Publish"],
                resources=[topic.topic_arn],
            )
        )

        return topic

    def _setup_organization_aggregator(
        self, aggregator_account: str, organization_arn: str
    ) -> None:
        """Setup organization-wide Config aggregator.

        Creates an aggregator that collects Config data from all accounts
        in the organization.

            organization_arn: The ARN of the organization

                config.CfnConfigurationAggregator.OrganizationAggregationSourceProperty(
                    all_aws_regions=True,  # Include all current and future regions
                    role_arn=self._get_or_create_aggregator_auth_role().role_arn,
                    organization_arn=organization_arn,
                ),
            ],
        )

        # Output the aggregator ARN
        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "ConfigAggregatorArn",
            description="ARN of the organization-wide Config aggregator",
            value=aggregator.attr_configuration_aggregator_arn,
        )

    def _get_or_create_aggregator_auth_role(self) -> iam.Role:
        """Get or create the IAM role for Config aggregator authorization.

        Returns:
            The IAM role for Config aggregator
        """
        role = iam.Role(
            self,
            "ConfigAggregatorAuthorizationRole",
            assumed_by=iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com"),
            managed_policies=[
                iam.ManagedPolicy.from_aws_managed_policy_name(
                    "service-role/AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations"
                ),
            ],
        )
        return role

    def _apply_cloudtrail_trail_enabled_rule(self) -> None:
        """Apply the CloudTrail trail enabled managed rule.

            self,
            "CloudTrailEnabledRule",
            config_rule_name="cloudtrail-enabled",
            description="Checks whether AWS CloudTrail is enabled in the AWS account",
            source=config.CfnConfigRule.SourceProperty(
                owner="AWS",
                source_identifier="CLOUD_TRAIL_ENABLED",
            ),
            scope=config.CfnConfigRule.ScopeProperty(
                compliance_resource_types=["AWS::CloudTrail::Trail"],
            ),
        )

        # Output the rule ARN
        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "CloudTrailEnabledRuleArn",
            description="ARN of the CloudTrail trail enabled Config rule",
            value=rule.attr_arn,
        )

    def _get_root_stack(self) -> Stack:
        """Get the root stack from the construct tree.

        Returns:
            The root Stack object
        """
        node = self.node
        while node.parent is not None:
            node = node.parent
        return node.root

    def _get_account_id(self) -> str:
        """Get the AWS account ID from the stack.

        Returns:
            The AWS account ID
        """
        root_stack = self._get_root_stack()
        if isinstance(root_stack, Stack):
            return root_stack.account
        return "000000000000"

"""AWS Config compliance monitoring and aggregation.

This component enables AWS Config recording across all regions, establishes an
organization-wide aggregator for centralized compliance monitoring, and applies
the managed rule that checks if AWS CloudTrail trails are enabled.
"""

from typing import Optional

from aws_cdk import (
    CfnOutput,
    RemovalPolicy,
    Stack,
    aws_config as config,
    aws_iam as iam,
    aws_s3 as s3,
    aws_ec2 as ec2,
)
from constructs import Construct


class ConfigCompliance(Construct):
    """Enable AWS Config recording and organization-wide compliance aggregation.

    This construct:
    - Enables AWS Config recording in all current and future regions
    - Creates an S3 bucket for Config snapshots
    - Sets up an organization-wide aggregator for centralized compliance
    - Applies the managed rule to verify CloudTrail is enabled
    """

    def __init__(self, scope: Construct, organization_id: str, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(scope, "ConfigCompliance", **kwargs)

        # Get all regions from EC2
        ec2_client = ec2.Vpc(
            self, "DummyVpc", cidr="10.0.0.0/16", nat_gateways=0
        ).availability_zones
        # This is a workaround to get the stack's region
        stack = Stack.of(self)
        primary_region = stack.region

        # Create S3 bucket for Config snapshots and configuration history
        config_bucket = s3.Bucket(
            self,
            "ConfigBucket",
            block_public_access=s3.BlockPublicAccess(
                block_public_acls=True,
                block_public_policy=True,
                ignore_public_acls=True,
                restrict_public_buckets=True,
            ),
            encryption=s3.BucketEncryption.KMS,
            versioned=True,
            enforcement_mode=s3.BucketEncryptionMode.ENFORCED,
            removal_policy=RemovalPolicy.RETAIN,
        )

        # Create IAM role for AWS Config
        config_role = iam.Role(
            self,
            "ConfigRole",
            assumed_by=iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com"),
            description="Role for AWS Config to read AWS resources",
        )

        # Attach AWS managed policies for Config
        config_role.add_managed_policy(
            iam.ManagedPolicy.from_aws_managed_policy_name(
                "ConfigRole"
            )
        )

        # Add permissions to access the S3 bucket
        config_bucket.grant_read_write(config_role)
        config_role.add_to_policy(
            iam.PolicyStatement(
                actions=[
                    "s3:GetBucketVersioning",
                    "s3:PutObject",
                    "s3:GetObject",
                ],
                resources=[config_bucket.bucket_arn, f"{config_bucket.bucket_arn}/*"],
            )
        )

        # Enable AWS Config Recorder in primary region
        recorder = config.CfnConfigurationRecorder(
            self,
            "ConfigRecorder",
            role_arn=config_role.role_arn,
            recording_group=config.CfnConfigurationRecorder.RecordingGroupProperty(
                all_supported=True,
                include_global_resources=True,
            ),
        )

        # Create delivery channel for Config to store snapshots in S3
        delivery_channel = config.CfnDeliveryChannel(
            self,
            "DeliveryChannel",
            s3_bucket_name=config_bucket.bucket_name,
            config_snapshot_delivery_properties=config.CfnDeliveryChannel.ConfigSnapshotDeliveryPropertiesProperty(
                delivery_frequency="TwentyFour_Hours"
            ),
        )

        # Ensure delivery channel is created before starting recorder
        delivery_channel.node.add_dependency(recorder)

        # Start the recorder
        recorder_status = config.CfnConfigurationRecorderStatus(
            self,
            "ConfigRecorderStatus",
            configuration_recorder_name=recorder.ref,
            depends_on=[recorder],
            is_enabled=True,
            is_multi_region_enabled=True,
        )

        # Create organization aggregator for centralized compliance
        aggregator = config.CfnConfigurationAggregator(
            self,
            "OrganizationAggregator",
            configuration_aggregator_name="organization-aggregator",
            account_aggregation_sources=[
                config.CfnConfigurationAggregator.AccountAggregationSourceProperty(
                    all_aws_regions=True,
                    account_ids=None,  # Will be set to organization root
                )
            ],
            organization_aggregation_sources=[
                config.CfnConfigurationAggregator.OrganizationAggregationSourceProperty(
                    all_aws_regions=True,
                    role_arn=self._create_organization_aggregator_role().role_arn,
                    organization_managed=True,
                )
            ],
        )

        # Apply managed rule: CloudTrail is enabled
        cloudtrail_enabled_rule = config.ManagedRule(
            self,
            "CloudTrailEnabledRule",
            config_rule_name="cloudtrail-enabled",
            identifier=config.ManagedRuleIdentifiers.CLOUD_TRAIL_ENABLED,
            maximum_execution_frequency=config.MaximumExecutionFrequency.TWELVE_HOURS,
        )

        # Outputs
        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "ConfigBucketName",
            description="S3 bucket for AWS Config snapshots",
            value=config_bucket.bucket_name,
        )

        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "ConfigRecorderName",
            description="AWS Config Recorder name",
            value=recorder.ref,
        )

        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "AggregatorName",
            description="Organization Config Aggregator name",

                resource_name="aws-service-role/config.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForConfig",

            self,

This component sets up AWS Config recording across all regions,
establishes an organization-wide aggregator, and applies managed rules
to check for CloudTrail enablement across all accounts.

from __future__ import annotations

from aws_cdk import CfnOutput, RemovalPolicy, Stack
from aws_cdk import aws_config as config
from aws_cdk import aws_iam as iam
from aws_cdk import aws_s3 as s3
from constructs import Construct


class AwsConfig(Construct):
    """Enable AWS Config recording and compliance monitoring organization-wide.

    This construct:
    - Creates an S3 bucket for storing Config snapshots and configuration history
    - Enables Config recording for all resource types across all regions
    - Establishes an organization-wide Config aggregator to view compliance
      across all accounts and regions
    - Applies the CloudTrail enabled managed rule to check that CloudTrail
      is active in every account

    Security Risk Mitigation:
        AWS Config provides visibility into resource configurations and compliance
        state across the organization. This helps detect:
        - Misconfigured resources that may expose security vulnerabilities
        - Unauthorized changes to critical resources
        - Non-compliance with organizational standards
        - Disabled security controls like CloudTrail

        By enabling Config recording across all regions and all current and future
        accounts, we ensure comprehensive visibility into the security posture
        of the entire organization.
    """

    _AGGREGATOR_NAME: str = "organization-config-aggregator"

    def __init__(self, scope: Construct, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(scope, "AwsConfig", **kwargs)

        # Create S3 bucket for Config snapshots and configuration history
        config_bucket = s3.Bucket(
            self,
            "ConfigBucket",
            encryption=s3.BucketEncryption.S3_MANAGED,
            block_public_access=s3.BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL,
            enforce_ssl=True,
            versioned=True,
            removal_policy=RemovalPolicy.RETAIN,
        )

        # Get the stack to determine account and region
        stack = Stack.of(self)

        # Create IAM role for Config
        config_role = iam.Role(
            self,
            "ConfigRole",
            assumed_by=iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com"),
            managed_policies=[
                iam.ManagedPolicy.from_aws_managed_policy_name(
                    "service-role/ConfigRole"
                ),
            ],
        )

        # Grant the Config role access to the bucket
        config_bucket.grant_read_write(config_role)

        # Create delivery channel for Config
        delivery_channel = config.CfnDeliveryChannel(
            self,
            "ConfigDeliveryChannel",
            s3_bucket_name=config_bucket.bucket_name,
            sns_topic_arn=None,
        )

        # Create Config recorder that records all resource types
        recorder = config.CfnConfigurationRecorder(
            self,
            "ConfigRecorder",
            role_arn=config_role.role_arn,
            recording_group=config.CfnConfigurationRecorder.RecordingGroupProperty(
                all_supported=True,
                include_global_resources=True,
                resource_types=None,
            ),
        )

        # Start the recorder
        recorder.add_depends_on(delivery_channel)

        recorder_status = config.CfnConfigurationRecorderStatus(
            self,
            "ConfigRecorderStatus",
            configuration_recorder_name=recorder.ref,
            delivery_channel_name=delivery_channel.ref,
            recording_enabled=True,
        )

        # Create organization-wide aggregator for multi-account, multi-region visibility
        aggregator = config.CfnConfigurationAggregator(
            self,
            "OrganizationAggregator",
            configuration_aggregator_name=self._AGGREGATOR_NAME,
            account_aggregation_sources=[
                config.CfnConfigurationAggregator.AccountAggregationSourceProperty(
                    all_aws_regions=True,
                    account_ids=[stack.account],
                )
            ],
            organization_aggregation_sources=[
                config.CfnConfigurationAggregator.OrganizationAggregationSourceProperty(
                    all_aws_regions=True,
                    role_arn=self._create_aggregator_role().role_arn,
                )
            ],
        )

        # Apply CloudTrail enabled managed rule
        cloudtrail_rule = config.CfnConfigRule(
            self,
            "CloudTrailEnabledRule",
            config_rule_name="cloudtrail-enabled",
            description="Checks whether AWS CloudTrail is enabled in the account.",
            source=config.CfnConfigRule.SourceProperty(
                source_identifier="CLOUD_TRAIL_ENABLED",
                source_type="AWS_CONFIG_MANAGED",
            ),
            scope=config.CfnConfigRule.ScopeProperty(
                compliance_resource_types=None,
            ),
        )

        # Ensure dependencies are set correctly
        cloudtrail_rule.add_depends_on(recorder_status)

        # Outputs
        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "ConfigBucketName",
            description="S3 bucket for AWS Config snapshots and configuration history",
            value=config_bucket.bucket_name,
        )

        CfnOutput(
            self,
            "ConfigAggregatorName",
            description="Organization-wide Config aggregator for multi-account compliance visibility",
            value=aggregator.configuration_aggregator_name,
        )

    def _create_aggregator_role(self) -> iam.Role:
        """Create IAM role for organization aggregator.

        Returns:
            The created IAM role with permissions to access Config in all accounts.
        """
        role = iam.Role(
            self,
            "ConfigAggregatorRole",
            assumed_by=iam.ServicePrincipal("config.amazonaws.com"),
            managed_policies=[
                iam.ManagedPolicy.from_aws_managed_policy_name(
                    "service-role/AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations"
                ),
            ],
        )

        return role
